{{Current events|year=2026|month=06|day=16|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[Hezbollah]] states that it received assurances from [[Iran]] that the withdrawal of [[Israel]]i [[Israeli Ground Forces|troops]] from [[Israeli occupation of Southern Lebanon (2026)|occupied]] [[southern Lebanon]] will be a demand in the next phase of negotiations with the [[United States]], before any deal about [[Nuclear program of Iran|Iran's nuclear program]]. [https://aje.news/79m19j?update=4667144 (Al Jazeera)]
****[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign minister]] [[Abbas Araghchi]] says that the continued Israeli occupation of Lebanon would be a violation of the Iran–US agreement. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-war-israel-lebanon-oil-june-16-2026-d79458506c46e3f4a78aef0f9d8b9250 (AP)]
**[[2026 Lebanon war]]
***Israeli [[airstrike]]s kill at least four people across southern Lebanon. [https://www.bssnews.net/international/396691 (AFP via BSS News)] [https://aje.news/79m19j?update=4667486 (Al Jazeera)]
***The [[Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces|Iranian military]] says that Israel has violated [[2026 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire|the ceasefire]] in [[Lebanon]] 84 times since the [[Islamabad Memorandum|Iran–US agreement]] was announced. [https://aje.news/79m19j?update=4667973 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2026 English Channel incident]]
**The [[Russian frigate Admiral Grigorovich|Russian frigate ''Admiral Grigorovich'']] fires warning shots at a [[yacht]] in the [[English Channel]] between Normandy and the [[Isle of Wight]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c20yzm84r7lo (BBC News)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[69th Annual Grammy Awards]]
**[[The Recording Academy]] of the [[Music of the United States|United States]] announces five new [[Grammy Award]] categories for 2027, including [[Grammy Award for Best Asian Pop Music Performance|Best Asian Pop Music Performance]], and revises eligibility rules for [[Grammy Award for Best New Artist|Best New Artist]], increasing the maximum number of prior submissions from three to four. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/entertainment/showbiz/celebrities/2026/6/17/new-asian-pop-and-folk-categories-announced-by-music-s-grammy-awards-0846 (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**The [[CEO]] of [[Mitsui O.S.K. Lines]], world's largest operator of [[Tanker (ship)|tanker ships]], says that it will take weeks to restore normal traffic through the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/strait-hormuz-transit-will-take-weeks-resume-largest-tanker-operator-tells-ft-2026-06-16/ (Reuters)]
**[[Bloomberg News|Bloomberg]] reports that [[QatarEnergy]] plans to resume [[liquefied natural gas]] (LNG) production within two months once the Strait of Hormuz officially [[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis|reopens]]. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/qatar-rapidly-restart-lng-exports-once-hormuz-reopens (Middle East Eye)] [https://pgjonline.com/news/2026/june/qatarenergy-ready-to-restore-lng-output-as-hormuz-reopens (''Pipeline and Gas Journal'')]
*The [[Bank of Japan]] raises its interest rate to 1% from 0.75%, the highest level since 1995. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjdgl213dpzo (BBC News)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-06-16/bank-of-japan-hike-shows-inflation-worries-strategists-say (Bloomberg)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Central Sulawesi earthquake]]
**One person is killed and 38 others are injured when a {{M|w|6.7}} earthquake strikes [[Palu]], [[Central Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-earthquake-palu-sulawesi-8f73f7a60b323b23015a632e4697d913 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/magnitude-67-quake-hits-indonesias-sulawesi-island-agency-says-2026-06-16/ (Reuters)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2026/06/15/indonesia-earthquake-palu-sulawesi/2375b5a0-6937-11f1-830e-133d20cadd28_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*At least nine people are killed, including two children, and 25 others are injured when a [[freight train]] collides with a bus in [[Triangle, Zimbabwe|Triangle]], [[Masvingo]], [[Zimbabwe]]. [https://apnews.com/article/zimbabwe-collision-deaths-children-bus-train-a182e1b5940cd934d8b8632f5fe350e4 (AP)]
*Six people are killed and 20 others are injured when a mini-[[dump truck]] collides with a [[pickup truck]] and plunges into a [[ravine]] in [[Labrador, Pangasinan]], [[Philippines]]. [https://english.news.cn/asiapacific/20260617/51f1b7797d1e48d3b3246d7eddb63015/c.html (Xinhua)] [https://mb.com.ph/2026/06/17/6-dead-in-pickup-truck-dump-truck-collision (''Manila Bulletin'')]
*One person is killed and eight others are injured when a {{M|w|6.3}} [[earthquake]] strikes [[Da Qaidam]], [[Haixi Prefecture|Haixi]], [[Qinghai]], [[China]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2026/06/16/china-earthquake-magnitude-dead-injured/90455578007/ (AFP via ''USA Today'')] [https://english.news.cn/20260617/2edc9caa99b8418bbf7f91f55d83ae00/c.html (Xinhua)]
*One person is killed and at least five others are injured when a [[NetJets]]-operated [[Cessna Citation Latitude]] [[business jet]], with a [[San José del Cabo]]–[[Austin, Texas|Austin]] route, catches fire after crashing on [[Loop 20]] highway in [[Laredo, Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2026/06/17/us/plane-crash-laredo-texas-highway-hnk (CNN)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Sudanese cholera epidemic (2024–present)|Sudanese cholera epidemic]]
**[[Sudan]] reports 36 suspected cases of [[measles]] in the [[States of Sudan|states]] of [[Khartoum State|Khartoum]] and [[White Nile State|White Nile]], alongside seven confirmed cases of [[cholera]] in [[West Kordofan]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article/315148 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*MapBiomas reports that water levels in the [[Brazil]]ian [[Brazilian Amazon|Amazon]] rise to 2.6% above the historical average in 2025 following increased rainfall. The organization warns that [[Climate change in Brazil|climate change]] and [[Deforestation of the Amazon rainforest|land-use changes]] continue to affect long-term hydrological stability. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/brazilian-amazon-waters-recover-after-two-years-of-drought-report (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Kenya relations]], [[Kenya–Taiwan relations]]
**[[Taiwan]] says the [[Kenya]]n [[Ministry of Foreign and Diaspora Affairs (Kenya)|foreign ministry]] revoked [[Visa policy of Kenya|visas]] issued to [[Science and technology in Taiwan|Taiwanese scientists]] and prevented them from attending the Our Ocean Conference in [[Mombasa]]. [[China]] states that Kenya's actions are consistent with its adherence to the [[One China]] policy. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/taiwan-says-its-delegates-have-been-barred-ocean-conference-kenya-2026-06-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Terrorism in the United States]]
**[[Director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation|U.S. FBI director]] [[Kash Patel]] announces that the [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] has thwarted a terrorist attack plot during the [[UFC Freedom 250]] event at the [[White House]] in [[Washington, D.C.]], with five people arrested for the plot. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2026/06/16/alleged-plot-to-attack-white-house-fight-night-thwarted-says-fbi_6754562_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/fbi-foils-alleged-plot-attack-white-house-ufc-event-patel-says-rcna350248 (NBC News)]
*[[Brazil]]'s [[Supreme Federal Court]] sentences former [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo]] [[Chamber of Deputies (Brazil)|congressman]] [[Eduardo Bolsonaro]] to four years and two months in prison and bars him from holding public office for eight years after convicting him of threatening public officials in connection with [[United States government sanctions|U.S. sanctions]] efforts. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/06/17/world/americas-emea/brazil-supreme-court-sentences-bolsonaros-son-over-us-lobbying/2367135 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*A [[United Nations]]-backed court in the [[Central African Republic]] begins for former [[List of heads of state of the Central African Republic|president]] [[François Bozizé]], who seized power in a military coup in [[2003 Central African Republic coup d'état|2003]], in [[Trial in absentia|absentia]] for [[Crimes against humanity|crimes against humanity]], including [[murder]], [[Enforced disappearance|enforced disappearances]], [[torture]], and [[rape]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2026/6/16/former-car-president-on-trial-in-absentia-over-crimes-against-humanity (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.africanews.com/amp/2026/06/16/former-car-president-faces-crimes-against-humanity-trial/ (Africanews)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Politics of Equatorial Guinea]]
**The entire [[Equatorial Guinea Council of Ministers|cabinet]] of [[Equatorial Guinea]], led by [[Prime Minister of Equatorial Guinea|prime minister]] [[Manuel Osa Nsue Nsua]], [[resigns]] after reaching under 10% of targets surrounding [[economic diversification]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4gy27dyq0ro (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/equatorial-guinea-government-resigns-due-missed-targets-vp-says-2026-06-16/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**The [[NASA]]'s [[James Webb Space Telescope]] discovers that the [[Hot Jupiter]] [[exoplanet]] [[HD 80606 b]] is being roasted by [[HD 80606|its home star]]. The research findings were presented at the 248th [[American Astronomical Society]] in [[Pasadena, California|Pasedena]], [[California]], U.S. [https://www.space.com/astronomy/exoplanets/james-webb-space-telescope-discovers-extreme-exoplanet-being-roasted-by-its-home-star (Space.com)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 FIFA World Cup]]
**[[Argentina at the FIFA World Cup]]
***In [[association football]], [[Argentina national football team|Argentine]] [[Forward (association football)|forward]] and captain [[Lionel Messi]] becomes the first male player to [[List of players who have appeared in the most FIFA World Cups|appear]] in six [[FIFA World Cup]]s and joins [[Germany national football team|Germany]]'s [[Miroslav Klose]] as [[List of FIFA World Cup top goalscorers|the tournament's all-time leading scorer]] with 16 goals after scoring a [[Hat-trick (association football)|hat-trick]] in Argentina's 3–0 win against [[Algeria national football team|Algeria]] in [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group J#Argentina vs Algeria|their opening match]]. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/sports/othersports/2026/6/17/magical-messi-equals-world-cup-goals-record-as-argentina-win-1215 (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
*In [[track and field]], American [[Sprint (running)|sprinter]] [[Noah Lyles]] runs 14.67 seconds in the [[150 metres]] at the [[Golden Spike Ostrava|Golden Spike]] meeting in [[Ostrava]], [[Czech Republic]], setting a [[List of world records in athletics|world record]] that surpassed the previous mark of 14.72 seconds. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/sports/20260616-lyles-sets-world-s-best-time-over-150-metres-at-ostrava (AFP via RFI)]
